    StartersHoney roasted carrots with whipped fetaBaby carrots roasted with honey and thyme, whipped feta and yoghurt dipHow to make it2 bunches of baby carrots2 tbsp honey4 sprigs of thyme30g butter, melted150g feta100g Greek yoghurtToss the carrots with honey, thyme and melted butter.Roast at 200°C for 25 minutes until caramelised.Whip the feta with the yoghurt for the dip. Share one with the reindeer.MainsArendelle meatballsBeef and pork meatballs with allspice in cream gravy, served with potatoesHow to make it300g beef mince300g pork mince50g breadcrumbs, soaked in milk1 onion, grated1/2 tsp allspice90g butter200ml beef stock150ml thickened cream1kg potatoes4 tbsp lingonberry jamMix the mince with the breadcrumbs, onion and allspice and roll into balls.Brown the meatballs in butter.Simmer in the stock and cream.Boil the potatoes, mash with some butter and serve with lingonberry jam.Ice harvesters' creamy Nordic fish soupThe men cutting ice on the frozen lakeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chunks of salmon and white fish poached in a creamy fish broth with leek, carrot and potato, finished with dill and served with buttered rye.Soften 1 sliced leek, 2 diced carrots and 1 diced celery stick in 30g butter for 5 minutes.Add 500g diced potato and 1.2 litres fish stock and simmer 12 minutes.Stir in 250ml cream and bring back to a gentle simmer.Add 400g diced white fish such as ling and 300g diced salmon and poach for 4 minutes without stirring hard.Season, add a handful of chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with buttered rye.SweetsEternal winter school breadSoft cardamom yeast buns filled with thick custardHow to make it450g plain flour7g dried yeast1 tsp ground cardamom60g caster sugar250ml warm milk1 egg60g butter300ml thick custard150g icing sugar50g desiccated coconutMix the flour, yeast, cardamom, sugar, milk, egg and butter into a dough and knead.Prove for 1 hour.Shape into buns and press a hollow in each. Fill with thick custard.Bake at 200°C for 12 minutes.Cool, then spread icing on top and dip in coconut.Coronation dark and white trufflesDark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa, white chocolate ones in icing sugarHow to make it150g dark chocolate200g white chocolate135ml thickened cream2 tbsp cocoa3 tbsp icing sugarMake the dark ganache by pouring hot cream over the dark chocolate. Make the white ganache the same way with the white chocolate.Chill both for 3 hours.Roll the dark ones in cocoa and the white ones in icing sugar like snow.Pile on a silver plate.DrinksOaken's cardamom hot chocolateHot milk steeped with cardamom and cinnamon, finished with chocolateHow to make it1 L full cream milk4 cardamom pods, lightly crushed1 cinnamon stick150g dark chocolate, chopped2 tbsp brown sugar1 pinch salt4 tbsp whipped cream1 handful mini marshmallowsWarm the milk with the cardamom and cinnamon until steaming.Turn off the heat and steep for 10 minutes. Strain.Return to the heat and whisk in the chocolate, sugar and salt until smooth and frothy.Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream, marshmallows and grated chocolate.
